body:
So this is something that happened to me about 14/15 years ago when I was only 23 years old, before I had ever taken any heavy drugs such as cocaine, heroine, ecstasy or shrooms. At this time I was a social drinker and a social marijuana smoker. I had yet been to any detoxes, rehabs or treatment facilities. I didn't consider myself an addict or an alcoholic back then.
[Erowid Note: 
Some authors report suspicions that their cannabis has been 'laced' (adulterated), in some cases, presumably with PCP. While this is possible, readers should be aware that idiosyncratic response to the effects of cannabis (usually higher doses) can lead some users to presume their cannabis has been 'laced'. There is no way to know if the cannabis in the report below was adulterated or not. Reports of plant material and cannabis laced with powerful synthetic cannabinoids and other psychoactive substances became more common starting in 2007.]
Never Mix Alcohol With PCP
I was just at a friend's party on a Saturday night trying to have a good time. This was also at a very good friend of mine's house, so there was no reason for me not to feel safe. I indulged that evening as I did on so many occasions when I was young. Having consumed 10 or so different alcoholic drinks from various coolers throughout the evening (some sweet, some not). Not really thinking there was anything to worry about. I also had consumed some caviar (which was disgusting). Then I recall some people in the living room hitting a bong with marijuana in it. At the time this was the norm for me and my friends. To get really, really drunk then smoke some weed. We used to call it 'getting fucked up' this was of course before any of us had been introduced to any heavy drugs such as cocaine or heroin or PCP for that matter.
Well I took a hit, a big hit at that prob cauz I was hammered. I remember coughing for several minutes. Which was unusual. I immediately realized that it wasn't just pot that I had smoked. I knew something was wrong. I was pissed. I started yelling at people sitting around, but nobody would fess up. Everyone just thought it was so funny and kept laughing at me. I didn't go home that night. I ended up trying to sleep there that night in a terrible
high. It was a horrible experience. Thankfully I had an awesome girlfriend who loved me very much at the the time. She stayed with me the whole night. Puking and sleeping here and there. Alcohol and pcp should never be mixed, NEVER! I honestly thought I was going to die that night. ... knowing what I know now. Having been through the rehabs, detoxes and meetings. I now understand that I am an addict/alcoholic. I now understand what PCP does and how it works. Drugs are nothing to be messed with. However they can be done recreationally in moderation. Everyone must know their limits.
